mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn can cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased costs for businesses, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, which can boost economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 12-month MA and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as liquidity increases.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests strong labor market conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200k & UNRATE < 5% and SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS < 6-month MA and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals a strengthening economy, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 > 12-month MA and SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
